sections.title: System Design Interview Foundations
sections.description: Build a repeatable interview process and the vocabulary needed to defend a design.

sections.title: Networking & APIs
sections.description: Trace requests, design interfaces, and select communication patterns at interview depth.

sections.title: Data & Storage
sections.description: Choose data models and scaling strategies from access patterns and correctness needs.

sections.title: Caching
sections.description: Use caches deliberately, including their consistency and failure costs.

sections.title: Messaging, Queues & Streaming
sections.description: Decouple work and reason precisely about ordering, retries, delivery, and replay.

sections.title: Reliability & Distributed Systems
sections.description: Handle partial failure, overload, coordination, and cross-region correctness.

sections.title: Observability & Security
sections.description: Make designs diagnosable and protect their architectural trust boundaries.

sections.title: Common Architecture Patterns
sections.description: Connect canonical concepts into repeatable interview moves without duplicating their lessons.

sections.title: Specialized Building Blocks
sections.description: Add specialized components only when a product requirement justifies them.

sections.title: Technology Deep Dives
sections.description: Map interview concepts to concrete technology choices, strengths, and limitations.
